fusions.name: Heft on the String
fusions.desc: Looses a shaft drawn with your whole weight for 30 damage, rising to 2 times that at its full reach of 9 tiles. It ignores the target's armour.

fusions.name: Sinew-Torn Shot
fusions.desc: Costs 4% of your maximum health. Overdraws a heavy shaft that strikes the first enemy in its path for 9 damage.

fusions.name: Long Heave
fusions.desc: After a 1-second draw, your attacks and spells reach 54% further for 15 seconds.

fusions.name: Drawn Tension
fusions.desc: Every hit you land adds a stack, up to 8. At 8 they all release at once: a blow strikes the nearest enemy within 8 tiles for 27% of your weapon damage per stack (218% at full). Unfed, a stack fades every 10 seconds.
